entities.name: Once retrieval
entities.description: A retrieval paradigm that aims to gather all pertinent information in a single operation.

entities.name: Iterative retrieval
entities.description: A retrieval paradigm that conducts further searches based on previously retrieved information.

entities.name: Multi-stage retrieval
entities.description: A retrieval paradigm where retrieval is divided into multiple stages, potentially using different retrievers.

entities.name: G-Retriever
entities.description: A method that utilizes an extended PCST algorithm to retrieve the most relevant subgraph.

entities.name: KagNet
entities.description: A method that extracts paths between all pairs of topic entities with lengths not exceeding k.

entities.name: Yasunaga et al.
entities.description: Researchers who extract the subgraph containing all topic entities along with their 2-hop neighbors.

entities.name: Taunk et al.
entities.description: Researchers who extract the subgraph containing all topic entities along with their 2-hop neighbors.

entities.name: Extended PCST algorithm
entities.description: An algorithmic strategy used by G-Retriever to retrieve the most relevant subgraph.

entities.name: Path extraction
entities.description: A strategy used by KagNet to extract paths between topic entities.

entities.name: 2-hop neighbor extraction
entities.description: A strategy used by Yasunaga et al. and Taunk et al. to extract subgraphs containing topic entities and their 2-hop neighbors.
